expected_direction.sdsc_bundle_gen: decrease (cache hits skip duplicate emissions on WB structural repetition)
expected_direction.dxp_standalone: maybe small decrease (smaller bundle handed to backend)
expected_direction.n_specs: may decrease (fewer distinct specs after dedup — if so, verdict shifts to STRUCTURAL_CHANGE_NEUTRAL)

rationale: The PR caches canonical SDSC JSON per unique op-spec and reuses it on repeated identical specs. WB is KV-chunked with structurally identical scores/exp/weighted computations per chunk, so many cache hits were expected. The added overhead per op (canonical compile + json.dumps sort_keys) was expected to be outweighed by skipped emissions.
